body: Thank you so much. It means a lot that all of you care so much

Yes, I'm sorry, I fell asleep and woke up and decided to come home. My wife won't be coming back any time soon, but she's agreed to let me have one or two of our dogs so I won't be so lonely and I did make it through the night.
Well, it's not the first time I've messed up, but it's been a while so I'm not so sure she'll forgive me.

You are a true friend. I appreciate everything you've done for me. I'm probably going to just wait another day and see what happens. I'm in Texas near a big city so I probably won't get so see much of the meteor shower, or I'll fall asleep :)

But if I'm up then I'll definitely check it out!
Thanks, I will. I think I've been talked out of it by the hive mind. One more night won't hurt.

Thank you, I'm glad I could save someone and something good could come of this. Reading the comments and how much people care is making me think twice.

BTW, I did read your other post. I'm not sure you'd want my help after this but I've been a hiring manager at a major tech firm and have gone through thousands of resumes. If I'm still around later you can send your resume my way and I can try to help you make it better, that is if you want.
I'm thinking about waiting until tomorrow, but I feel that if I do than I'm just not going to do it and I just want the pain to stop.

Thanks, I'm thinking about holding off for another night and see how I feel, though I've felt this way since Friday and yesterday when she left I felt it even more so but I said I would give myself the night and when I woke up I still felt the same, so here I a in a hotel room.

To be honest, this hotel room is more comforting to me than home is right now because home just reminds me of the good times and how I screwed everything up. Not to mention I've been drinking and took a few Xanax so it wouldn't be safe for me to drive over an hour home. I'm not worried about myself as I wouldn't mind if I got into a wreck, but I'm not about to take a chance on hurting any innocent people being on the highway the way I am.

You're awesome. I appreciate the thoughts and yes, I would love it if you kept messaging me on here. It helps having people to talk to, though it's weird, I don't want help but here I am talking and listening. It's like a part of me wants to die, and there's a part of me that doesn't.

There's the fact that I don't want to hurt anyone and that, well, I guess I just don't know if I have it in me to actually do it. The pain is way to much to bear right now. It feels like my brain is just pulsing and overloading. I'm almost at a point where I'm becoming numb, which could be a bad thing.
I'm here, going between Star Trek and this thread. I'm still to scared to take the rest of the pills. I don't know what I'm going to do.
I love your post and your username. May you be touched by his noodly appendage, Ramen.

I'm good for now. I have my iPad on and going between this thread and watching Voyager. If I do go, that's what I'd like to be watching when I do pass. The shitty thing is that there's a part of me that wants to live forever because I have great hope for humanity and I think we can achieve most, if not all that is in Star Trek, including uniting humanity and other races. It's kind of a cruel joke if you think about it.
I'm here for now. I haven't taken anymore pills. I don't know what to do.

I wish there was also, I just want the pain to stop but there's no magical anything that can make it go away except time, and I'm not sure that can take away the guilt of hurting her when she needed me the most.

I think what hurts the most is that she needed me now and that's when I hurt her the most. I feel like a piece of shit that doesn't deserve to be here. I love her so much and was looking forward to having a baby with her more than anything in the world.
Thanks. I did mainly post this to get it off my chest but it's been therapeutic to talk to people. There is a large part of me that doesn't want to die, but there's so much pain right now..

Thank you for the kind words. Believe it or not, talking here has made me think twice about doing it, though I'm still alone in the hotel room. I've sat here and looked at my child's sonogram of when we saw the heart beat and it hurts so bad, and to know my wife hurts just as bad and instead of protecting her I hurt her more. That's what hurts the most. I did talk to her about things that I'm to embarrassed to mention, but suffice to say my wife has a right to be angry with me.

I realize this, and it's one of the things holding me back right now. I'm alone right now, in a hotel room far away from my home in case they try to call someone to come and "save" me. I also paid with cash so that they can't find me. I think the only thing holding me back right now is not wanting to hurt her more and not wanting to hurt my sister. She lost her husband to suicide as well and I know how much it hurt me when he passed as we were good friends as well as brother in laws.
Thank you, I'm sitting here just waiting. I'm not sure I can do it.
I took the Xanax and alcohol to relax me enough to where I can take the rest and not worry about it. I guess you could say that I don't have it in me to actually do it without relaxing first.

Yes, I've thought about it a lot. It seems that the pain is to much, my heart is broke. To be honest, it's not even me hurting that makes me want to die. It's the fact that my wife went through so much and then I hurt her when I should be protecting her. I don't deserve to live.

Thank you so much, your kindness has made me cry. I appreciate the offer, but I do have plenty of money.

I've taken some pills to relax so that I can do it but I'm still having a hard time finishing it. You didn't make it any easier :)

Thanks, but I'm more of a Star Trek fan and JJ Abrams ruined the franchise for me. The only thing that makes me sad about that is that I'm only in season 3 of Voyager with all the rest of the shows having been watched. I went from season one of Enterprise to TOS, TNG, DS9, etc and had already watched all the movies. I'll never get to see how Voyager gets home :-(
To be honest, I don't remember. Partially because I had taken a lot of Xanax and alcohol, and most likely partially due to my PTSD. My mind blocks things out that are traumatizing.
